offers.name: Product Development Sprint
offers.fit: A product, app, workflow, or website needs to be designed, built, improved, or shipped.
offers.boundary: The published $6,000/month starting price has a 90-day minimum. Exact scope is agreed before work begins. Do not promise availability or a business result. Mention price only when asked.

offers.name: Search-led GTM
offers.fit: An existing business wants SEO and AI Search to work as part of its go-to-market system: map buyer demand, improve Google and AI discovery, build useful search assets, and measure commercial visibility. Search-Led GTM is Ankur's offer framing, not a universally established category.
offers.boundary: The published $6,000/month starting price has a 90-day minimum. Exact scope is agreed before work begins. Do not claim a ranking, citation, traffic, lead, or revenue result without specific evidence. Mention price only when asked.

offers.name: Character-led marketing
offers.fit: A software or founder-led product needs a mascot or brand character to explain the product, support a launch, or carry recurring content. Work can begin with a character sprint, launch kit, or content engine.
offers.boundary: No fixed public price or minimum term has been published for character-led marketing. Scope depends on concepts, animation, assets, and usage rights. Whooshly and Pepys are Ankur's own product examples, not client outcomes. Do not promise reach, conversions, viral distribution, or legal/IP clearance.
